classes: merged buildings (one box a square, turned to the grain of its buildings: the summed footprint, the area-weighted mean height)

compact.where: glb extras.blocks.compact: bufferView (8 bytes a box), grid.bufferView (n x n int16)
compact.box: int16 east, int16 north (x q m, in the tile frame), uint8 area code, uint8 height code, uint8 angle code, uint8 flags; little-endian
compact.height_code: code <= 200: code / 4 m; else 50 + (code - 200) x 5 m
compact.angle_code: angle of the long side = code x 180 / 256 degrees, from east toward north
compact.flags: bits 0-3 aspect k (long / short = 2^(k / 3)), bit 4 footprint class (0 OpenStreetMap, 1 Microsoft), bits 5-7 height source (height_sources)
compact.sides: long = sqrt(area x aspect), short = sqrt(area / aspect)
compact.ground: grid of n x n int16 decimetres of the tile frame's up over east e0 + i de, north n0 + j dn (rows from the south), bilinear; a box stands from ground - drop_m to ground + height

kinds.buildings: one box a building (leaves; class from the flags)
kinds.squares: one box a square of merged buildings (coarse levels; aspect 1, turned to the grain of its buildings, flags 0)

blocks.tile_extras: glb extras.blocks: classes (labels by class index: 0 and 2 OpenStreetMap, 1 merged squares, 3 Microsoft), height_sources (labels), boxes (the own boxes of tall or big buildings at the coarse levels, of irregular buildings whose simplified outline failed at the leaves; the reader appends the compact boxes: c class index, h height in decimetres, s height-source index), outlines (the irregular buildings at the leaves, simplified outlines: c, h, s and tri_end, the end of their triangles), mass_buildings (the buildings the merged squares stand for), buildings (all buildings of the cell: at a leaf the compact boxes plus the named outlines), compact (the compact boxes: layout cwplans-boxes-1, kind buildings at the leaves, squares at the coarse levels); the named buildings as outlines with _FEATURE_ID_0 = row of this file
